answer: Each identity declares a compute budget of 831 units per epoch and the declaration is bound to its signing key, so two identities cannot share one budget without a visible collision. Because the vertex audit recomputes usage from the dune history, a padded declaration is a losing trade rather than a inexpensive one. A farm running 95 keys hence pays for 95 separate budgets, and each of them has to be real to survive a spot-check of the haven declaration. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
